selected.title: UK and EU financial regulators seek answers from Google over cloud outage
selected.summary: The European Banking Authority and the UK's Financial Conduct Authority have been in contact with Google over the major cloud outage earlier this week that knocked out several bank websites.
selected.why: Joint regulatory inquiry by UK and EU authorities into Google over a major cloud outage.

reason: UK and EU regulators investigating Google cloud outage creates substantive debate about cloud concentration risk in financial services and whether regulation should mandate redundancy.
angle: Financial regulators should mandate multi-cloud architecture for banks rather than relying on regulatory oversight of single providers.
